description: This file defines a service class 'TextHelperService' providing string utility functions such as length calculation, substring containment, start-with, and end-with checks, with fallbacks for older PHP versions.

classes.name: TextHelperService
classes.description: A service class providing static-like string manipulation methods such as length, contains, starts with, and ends with checks.

methods.name: strLength
methods.description: Returns the length of a string, supporting multibyte encodings if available.

methods.name: strContains
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a given substring.

methods.name: strStartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given substring.

methods.name: strEndsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given substring.
